requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: art direction proposal for a 2D browser renovation game, single finished room illustration, 3:2 landscape. This is a proposal, not a runtime background.
Primary request: redesign a cozy small Mediterranean grocery shop as a polished, readable, orthographic 2.5D game diorama, with one mathematically consistent room, one camera, one light source, believable contact and occlusion. Crisp, appealing casual-game craftsmanship, restrained detail, substantial rounded forms and matte materials. Original art, no existing game characters or brands.
Scene: inside a compact rectangular coastal shop with warm cream plaster walls, turquoise painted wood trim, honey-colored wooden floor, timber beams, a window with a glimpse of the blue sea and a turquoise open doorway on the LEFT side. Three-quarter elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, no wide-angle lens, no converging lines. The visible left and right walls form a true 90-degree room corner; their two floor axes project at approximately plus and minus 30 degrees. Every cabinet and counter follows one of those two axes exactly; all verticals are parallel. No arbitrary rotation of any furniture.
Composition: two modest connected wall display cabinets form a tidy L along the two walls, starting AFTER the doorway and fitting below the window. These are real wall-depth cabinets, not giant obstacles. Keep a clearly visible unobstructed route from the left door to the cash counter. A substantial turquoise cash counter in the right foreground is parallel to the right wall and shelves, separated from them by a believable staff aisle. One gold vintage register stands squarely on its surface. Arrange furniture as a coherent compact shop, occupying useful space with an intentionally clear central customer aisle. No huge empty floor, no floating props.
Merchandise: upper shelves hold a few orderly groups of milk bottles, red jam jars and amber honey jars, all with the SAME room camera and lighting, correct small scale and individual grounding shadows. Fruit and bread rest INSIDE broad low-front wooden produce bins integrated into the middle shelves. Each bin has a visible rear wall, two side walls and a LOW front lip that naturally hides just the bottom of the pears/lemons/loaves. Contents have volume and correctly sit on the bin floor. The bins are entirely contained on the cabinet shelf depth. Bread is clustered naturally rather than pasted upright icons. Closed cabinet bases provide structure.
Style: much simpler and calmer than shiny hyper-detailed generated shop paintings: soft bevels, bold silhouettes, smooth turquoise paint, subtle wood grain, unified soft daylight from the left window, consistent shadows beneath every object. No excessive wicker microtexture. Merchandise supports the furniture silhouette rather than dominating it.
Avoid: UI, text, title plaques, category labels, price numerals, numbers, arrows, stars, buttons, floating cutout items, frontal product icons, fake rugs, doormats, stacks of shopping baskets on the floor, crates or pallets lying in the aisle, random filler decor, people, fisheye, mismatched vanishing points, furniture crossing the door threshold, transparent background.
The result must look like a single designed 3D scene rendered as 2D game art, with visibly consistent shelf planes and counter planes.

Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: NEW art-direction proposal for an original cozy coastal grocery renovation game. Reference image is a strict orthographic 3D layout guide, NOT a loose mood reference.
Primary request: turn the supplied geometry guide into a beautiful stylized 2.5D GAME DIORAMA, preserving its camera, bounding silhouettes, floor plan and parallel edges exactly. Keep the entire cutaway room visible, the same 3:2 landscape frame and the same elevated orthographic view. Every edge along the right wall, its three cabinet sections, shelves and foreground cash counter must remain at the SAME plus-30-degree screen slope. All edges along the left wall and low display remain at the matching minus-30-degree slope. Verticals remain vertical. Do not change camera to a lower eye-level perspective. No lens or vanishing points.
Geometry invariants: rectangular 5x4 meter room; corner in the upper center; open entrance on left wall near the lower left; one wide window on that left wall above a LOW connected display cabinet. Right-wall display cabinet has three equal open shelving bays and closed turquoise cabinet bases. Left-wall display is low, beneath the window, with two wide shallow produce bins. Counter in the foreground-right is parallel to the right wall, with a clean visible staff aisle separating it from the right-wall display. The box on the counter represents a small gold vintage register, replace only its appearance while keeping its position and footprint. Do not extend any furniture into the door opening. No extra furniture or boxes.
Materials and visual style: premium casual-game diorama, broad readable silhouettes, modest soft bevels, tasteful warm cream plaster, clean matte turquoise cabinet panels, honey-colored wooden tops, subtle wood texture. Gently stylized painted-3D game art with controlled detail. Do NOT make a hyper-realistic interior photograph or ornate microtextured decorative illustration. NO thick black comic outlines.
Merchandise, rendered FROM THE SAME elevated orthographic camera: a few neatly spaced milk bottles, red jam jars and amber honey jars on upper shelves of the right-wall cabinet. Bottom shelf of each of the three bays contains pears, lemons or loaves in the shallow integrated wooden bin already present in the guide. The left low display contains two produce groups in its existing two bins. All goods are correctly small relative to the cabinets, physically resting on the bin floors, behind their low front lips; no goods pasted as frontal icons. At most four or five pieces of fruit in a group so their placement is legible. Each shelf rim genuinely occludes the bottom of goods. Every milk bottle is much shorter than a shelf bay.
Add daylight and a glimpse of bright blue sea through the existing left door and window, same single soft light source from upper left, subtle contact shadows under furniture and merchandise. Finish cabinet fronts with simple recessed panels and small brass knobs. Add window trim and a modest timber beam along the two wall tops, preserving wall directions. Keep floor uncluttered and all aisles readable.
Absolutely no UI, writing, numbers, signs, category plaques, prices, arrows, stars, rugs, doormats, pallets, loose crates, baskets on the floor, potted plants on the floor, random decorative filler, people, logos or watermark. Do not redesign the layout. This is a compact functional shop with coherent planes and natural occlusion.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: middle renovation state of an original 2D game room proposal.
Edit target: supplied finished orthographic shop image. Preserve EXACT camera, framing, 3:2 canvas, room silhouette, door opening, window, ocean view, walls, floor, shadows, three right-wall shelving bays, two left-wall produce bins, all cabinet depths, counter position and the direction of every edge. Do not repaint or redesign furniture.
Change ONLY the completion state: remove ALL merchandise from EVERY shelf and produce bin (all milk, jam, honey, fruits and bread), and remove the gold register from the foreground counter. Keep every empty wooden bin and every empty shelf intact, with visible inner floors and low front lips. The result shows the shop after renovation and furniture installation, ready for stocking. Keep the same polished stylized game-art materials and light. Absolutely no added tools, crates, rugs, plants, signs, labels, numbers, UI or people. Only emptying surfaces; the spatial layout must not move.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: initial abandoned state of an original 2D renovation game room proposal.
Edit target: supplied finished orthographic shop image. Preserve EXACT elevated orthographic camera, framing, 3:2 canvas, floor plan, room silhouette, door opening, window, and the distant coastal view. Both walls and floor must retain the SAME projected axes; do not rotate the camera. Keep clear doorway and clear floor.
Change the room to an empty abandoned shop BEFORE renovation: remove all installed turquoise display cabinets, shelves, produce bins, foreground counter and gold register; remove ALL merchandise. Reveal the empty same wall and floor behind them. Keep architecture intact but worn: faded cream plaster with modest cracks and chipped lower areas, dull scratched wooden floor, weathered timber edging, old unpainted door/window frames, dusty slightly opaque window panes. The ceiling-edge beams remain in precisely the same places. Communicate age through the fixed architectural surfaces, not random debris. Same stylized 2.5D game-art language and same coherent light direction, slightly quieter colors. Absolutely no piles of rubble, junk props, rugs, crates, shopping baskets, plants, texts, UI, people, arrows or labels. The identical room awaits large visible renovation changes.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: finished coastal-shop orthographic concept supplied.
Change ONLY the orientation of the small gold cash register on the foreground counter: rotate this register exactly 180 degrees around its vertical axis while keeping its base in the exact same position and footprint and keeping the same size. Its keypad must face the STAFF AISLE between the counter and the back-wall shelves (toward the upper right/back wall), so a shopkeeper behind the counter can operate it. The customer-side camera should see the register's attractive plain curved brass back and left side, not its key buttons. Keep it square to the counter; do not turn it at 45 degrees. Preserve the cylinder/handle style and gold material. Do not introduce writing on the register.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE completely unchanged: camera, canvas, room geometry, shelf count, merchandise, all individual fruits/jars/bottles/bread, door/window/ocean, lighting, shadow direction, counter and furniture. No UI, characters, text, new props, plants, rugs or filler. Exact single-object correction.
